summary: Prestige Consumer Healthcare Inc., through its subsidiary PBH Australia Holding Company Pty Limited, entered a Sale and Purchase Deed to acquire all shares of five Australian companies (including LaCorium Health Australia Pty Limited, Stantail Trading Pty Limited, Stantail International Pty Limited, Brands Worldwide Holdings I.P. Pty Limited, and Laderma Holdings Pty Limited) from Tailor Investments Pty Limited, Standive Pty Limited, and individuals Steven David Sher, Delon Badler, and Clive Howard Sher for ~$150M cash, subject to customary adjustments. The target is a leader in Australian therapeutic skin care. The transaction is expected to close in Q2 of fiscal 2027. Purchaser obtained warranty and indemnity insurance as sole recourse for breaches, except fraud. Termination rights exist for breach if uncured by October 1, 2026. Watch for regulatory clearance and closing conditions.
